description: This file defines structures, classes, and macros related to a 64-bit timestamp counter used in an embedded firmware project. It includes an implementation of a 64-bit overflow counter with methods to update and retrieve the current time value.

classes.name: Overflow64Counter
classes.description: A class managing a 64-bit overflow counter with methods to retrieve current time and update the counter (the latter primarily for testing).

methods.name: updateAndSet
methods.description: Updates the provided State64 structure with a new 32-bit value by modifying its high and low bits.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp value stored within the overflow counter.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the counter with a new value; available only when EFI_UNIT_TEST is enabled.
